pages: Surah Al-Feel !05 ‘name of God, the entirely nmitercifut, the especially merciful

105:1- Have you not considered how our Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? 105:2 - Did He not make their plot go astray (fail)? 105:3 - And sent against them flocks of birds, 105:4 - Striking them with stones of hard clay, 105:5 - And made them like eaten straw(chaff).
